question: How many orders are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders;

question: How many unique customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers;

question: How many orders have the status 'delivered'?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered';

question: What is the average review score, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score)::numeric, 2) FROM order_reviews;

question: Which state has the most sellers?
sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS num_sellers FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY num_sellers DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many products are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products;

question: Which payment type appears in the most payment records, and how many payment records does it have?
sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS num_payments FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY num_payments DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the total value of all payments, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(payment_value)::numeric, 2) FROM order_payments;

question: Which 5 cities have the most unique customers?
sql: SELECT customer_city, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS num_customers FROM customers GROUP BY customer_city ORDER BY num_customers DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the highest price of a single item?
sql: SELECT MAX(price) FROM order_items;

question: Which product category (English name) has the most items sold?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS items_sold
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
ORDER BY items_sold DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Customers from which state placed the most orders?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS num_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY num_orders DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average review score for orders with status 'delivered', rounded to 2 decimals?
sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.review_score)::numeric, 2)
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered';

question: Sellers from which state earn the most revenue?
sql: SELECT s.seller_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price)::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average shipping cost per item for customers in Rio de Janeiro state (RJ)?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(oi.freight_value)::numeric, 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ';

question: How many orders were placed in 2017?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp < '2018-01-01';

question: Which month had the most orders?
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS num_orders FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY num_orders DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many orders were placed each year?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) AS year, COUNT(*) AS num_orders FROM orders GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question: On average, how many days does it take for an order to be delivered?
sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date::timestamp
                                   - order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders
WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

question: How many orders were delivered later than the estimated delivery date?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND order_delivered_customer_date::date > order_estimated_delivery_date::date;

question: What percentage of orders have the status 'delivered'?
sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2)
FROM orders;

question: How many customers placed more than one order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS repeat_customers;

question: What is the average total payment per order?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_total)::numeric, 2) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS order_total FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id) AS t;

question: Customers in which state wait the longest for delivery on average?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date::timestamp - o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_days DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many orders contain more than one item?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS t;

question: Which product category (English name) generates the most revenue?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price)::numeric, 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: What is the average review score for late orders compared to on-time orders? Label the groups 'late' and 'on time'.
sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date::date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date
       THEN 'late' ELSE 'on time' END AS delivery_status,
  ROUND(AVG(r.review_score)::numeric, 2) AS avg_score
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY delivery_status;

question: Which 3 sellers have received the most orders?
sql: SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS num_orders FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY num_orders DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Customers from which city spent the most money in total?
sql: SELECT c.customer_city, ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_spent FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_city ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which month in 2018 had the highest revenue?
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.price)::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which sellers have sold more than 1,000 items?
sql:

FROM order_items
GROUP BY seller_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000
ORDER BY items_sold DESC;

question: Which customer states have an average review score below 4.0?
sql:
SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
HAVING AVG(r.review_score) < 4.0
ORDER BY avg_score;

question: Which product categories (English name) have more than 5,000 items sold?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS items_sold
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name

question: How many items fall into each price band: low (under 50), medium (50-199.99), high (200+)? Label the bands 'low', 'medium' and 'high'.
sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN price < 50  THEN 'low'
    WHEN price < 200 THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'high'
  END AS price_band,
  COUNT(*) AS items
FROM order_items
GROUP BY price_band
ORDER BY MIN(price);

question: For each payment type, how many payments were paid in exactly 1 installment vs more than 1 installment?
sql:
SELECT payment_type,
  SUM(CASE WHEN payment_installments = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_installment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN payment_installments > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_installment
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY payment_type;

question: For each customer state, how many orders have status 'delivered' vs any other status?
sql:
SELECT c.customer_state,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status <> 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_delivered
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY not_delivered DESC;

question: How many items have a price above the average item price?

question: Who are the top 5 sellers by revenue, and which state are they in?
sql:
WITH seller_revenue AS (
  SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY seller_id
)
SELECT sr.seller_id, s.seller_state, ROUND(sr.revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue
FROM seller_revenue sr
JOIN sellers s ON sr.seller_id = s.seller_id

question: Using each order's total payment value, how many orders fall into each band: under 100, 100-499.99, 500+? Label the bands 'under_100', '100_to_499' and '500_plus'.
sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN total < 100 THEN 'under_100'
    WHEN total < 500 THEN '100_to_499'
    ELSE '500_plus'
  END AS value_band,
  COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM order_totals
GROUP BY value_band
ORDER BY MIN(total);

question: Rank the top 10 product categories (English name) by revenue.
sql:
WITH cat_rev AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
         SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
)
SELECT category,
       ROUND(revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rnk
FROM cat_rev
ORDER BY rnk
LIMIT 10;

question: Who is the top seller by revenue in each state?
sql:
WITH seller_rev AS (
  SELECT s.seller_state, oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
  GROUP BY s.seller_state, oi.seller_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_state ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn
  FROM seller_rev
)
SELECT seller_state, seller_id, ROUND(revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: How many orders were placed each month, and how did that change from the previous month?
sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       orders,
       LAG(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month,
       orders - LAG(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;

question: What is the median delivery time in days, from purchase to delivery?
sql:
SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (
         ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date::timestamp
                                      - order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp)) / 86400))::numeric, 2) AS median_delivery_days
FROM orders
WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

question: What percentage of delivered orders arrived later than the estimated date?
sql:
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date::date > order_estimated_delivery_date::date
                   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_late
FROM orders
WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

question: Do late orders get worse reviews? For late vs on-time orders, show the average review score and the number of orders. Label the groups 'late' and 'on time'.
sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date::date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date
       THEN 'late' ELSE 'on time' END AS delivery_status,
  ROUND(AVG(r.review_score)::numeric, 2) AS avg_score,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS num_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: Which month had the highest revenue?
sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price)::numeric, 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: For states with at least 1,000 reviews, what percentage of reviews are 5 stars?
sql:
SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_5_star,
       COUNT(*) AS reviews
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY pct_5_star DESC;

question: What is the running total of revenue month by month?
sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) AS month,
         SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)::numeric, 2) AS running_total
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;

question: Which 5 product categories have the slowest average delivery time in days? Only include categories with at least 500 delivered items. Use English category names.
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date::timestamp
                                     - o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days,
       COUNT(*) AS items
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500
ORDER BY avg_days DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: What percentage of total revenue comes from the top 10 sellers?
sql:
WITH seller_rev AS (
  SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY seller_id
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT revenue FROM seller_rev
  ORDER BY revenue DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT ROUND((100.0 * (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM top10)
                    / (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM seller_rev))::numeric, 2) AS pct_top10;

question: What share of total payment value does each payment type account for?
sql:
SELECT payment_type,
       ROUND(SUM(payment_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_value,
       ROUND((100.0 * SUM(payment_value) / SUM(SUM(payment_value)) OVER ())::numeric, 2) AS pct_share
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY pct_share DESC;

question: What percentage of unique customers placed more than one order?
sql:
WITH cust AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n_orders > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_repeat
FROM cust;

question: What was the month-over-month revenue growth (%) during 2017?
sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) AS month,
         SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp <  '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND((100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))
                    / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))::numeric, 2) AS growth_pct
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;

question: What percentage of items were sold to a customer in the same state as the seller?
sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.seller_state = c.customer_state THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_same_state
FROM order_items oi
JOIN sellers s   ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
JOIN orders o    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id;

question: Which 5 customers spent the most in total, and how many orders did each place?
sql:
SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n_orders,
       ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_spent
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c      ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id

question: What are the top 3 product categories (English name) by items sold in each of SP, RJ, and MG?
sql:
WITH state_cat AS (
  SELECT c.customer_state,
         COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
         COUNT(*) AS items
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN products p  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
  WHERE c.customer_state IN ('SP', 'RJ', 'MG')
    AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.customer_state, COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_state
                               ORDER BY items DESC, category) AS rn
  FROM state_cat
)
SELECT customer_state, category, items
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY customer_state, items DESC;

question: For repeat customers, how many days on average pass between their first and second order?
sql:
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
         o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp AS order_ts,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_unique_id
                            ORDER BY o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) AS rn,
         LAG(o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_unique_id
                                                          ORDER BY o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) AS prev_ts
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_ts - prev_ts)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days_to_second_order,
       COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM ordered
WHERE rn = 2;

question: For each month of 2018, how many orders were placed and what was the change from the previous month?
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, orders, orders - LAG(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change FROM m ORDER BY month;

question: Who is the top seller by revenue in each of the states SP, RJ and MG?
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT se.seller_state, oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers se ON oi.seller_id = se.seller_id WHERE se.seller_state IN ('SP', 'RJ', 'MG') GROUP BY se.seller_state, oi.seller_id), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_state ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn FROM s) SELECT seller_state, seller_id, ROUND(revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY seller_state;

question: Out of all orders that have a review, what percentage received a 1-star review?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN review_score = 1 THEN order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS pct_1_star FROM order_reviews;

question: For the 5 categories with the most products, what is the average product weight in grams?
sql: WITH top AS (SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_category_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, ROUND(AVG(p.product_weight_g)::numeric, 2) AS avg_weight_g FROM products p JOIN top ON p.product_category_name = top.product_category_name LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_weight_g DESC;

question: How many order items are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_items_count FROM order_items;

question: How many distinct sellers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS sellers_count FROM sellers;

question: What is the average product weight in grams, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(product_weight_g)::numeric, 2) AS avg_weight_g FROM products;

question: How many orders have at least one review?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_with_review FROM order_reviews;

question: What is the highest freight value on a single order item, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(freight_value)::numeric, 2) AS max_freight_value FROM order_items;

question: How many distinct product categories (Portuguese name) exist in the products table?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) AS distinct_categories FROM products;

question: How many payments were made by voucher?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS voucher_payments FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'voucher';

question: How many reviews are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_reviews FROM order_reviews;

question: How many distinct customers are from the state of SP?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customers_count FROM customers WHERE customer_state = 'SP';

question: What is the earliest order purchase timestamp?
sql: SELECT MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS earliest_order FROM orders;

question: What is the average total freight per order (summing freight per order first), rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_freight)::numeric, 2) AS avg_freight_per_order FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(freight_value) AS order_freight FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) x;

question: What is the average product description length, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(product_description_lenght)::numeric, 2) AS avg_description_length FROM products;

question: How many orders contain at least 3 items?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_count FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) x;

question: How many distinct cities have at least one seller?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_city) AS seller_cities FROM sellers;

question: What is the total freight value across all order items, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(freight_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_freight FROM order_items;

question: On average, how many days pass between a review being created and answered, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (review_answer_timestamp - review_creation_date)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_response_days FROM order_reviews;

question: How many orders have been approved (have an approval timestamp)?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS approved_orders FROM orders WHERE order_approved_at IS NOT NULL;

question: Which customer state has the highest average freight value per item, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(oi.freight_value)::numeric, 2) AS avg_freight FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_freight DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many products have a weight above 5000 grams?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS heavy_products FROM products WHERE product_weight_g > 5000;

question: What is the average payment value for credit_card payments, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_value)::numeric, 2) AS avg_credit_card_payment FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card';

question: How many orders were purchased in December 2017?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-12-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01';

question: Which month had the most orders in 2018?
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For each order status, how many orders are there?
sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: What is the average delivery time in days for delivered orders placed by customers in SP, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND c.customer_state = 'SP';

question: Which 5 sellers have the highest average price per item, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT seller_id, ROUND(AVG(price)::numeric, 2) AS avg_price FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each payment type, show the total payment value and its share of all payments, rounded to 2 decimals.
sql: SELECT payment_type, ROUND(SUM(payment_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_value, ROUND((100.0 * SUM(payment_value) / SUM(SUM(payment_value)) OVER ())::numeric, 2) AS share FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY total_value DESC;

question: How many orders were handed to the carrier but never delivered to the customer?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_count FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL;

question: For each review score, what is the average review response time in days, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT review_score, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (review_answer_timestamp - review_creation_date)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_response_days FROM order_reviews GROUP BY review_score ORDER BY review_score;

question: Which 3 product categories (English name) have the highest average item price, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, ROUND(AVG(oi.price)::numeric, 2) AS avg_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 3;

question: What is the total payment value from customers in RJ, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(op.payment_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_payment FROM order_payments op JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = op.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ';

question: How many distinct products have been sold (appear in order items)?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_products_sold FROM order_items;

question: What percentage of payments used more than one installment, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND((100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_installments > 1) / COUNT(*))::numeric, 2) AS pct_installment_payments FROM order_payments;

question: Which seller has sold items to the most distinct customer states?
sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_state) AS state_count FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY state_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For each year, what is the average review score, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS year, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score)::numeric, 2) AS avg_review_score FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY year;

question: What is the running total of order counts month by month?
sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp)) SELECT month, order_count, SUM(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_total FROM monthly ORDER BY month;

question: For the top 5 product categories (English name) by revenue, show the category, the revenue, and the rank.
sql: WITH cat_rev AS (SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)) SELECT category, ROUND(revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rank FROM cat_rev ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What was the month-over-month revenue growth percentage during 2018, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)) SELECT month, ROUND(revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue, ROUND((100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))::numeric, 2) AS growth_pct FROM monthly ORDER BY month;

question: Among delivered orders, which customer state has the highest percentage of late deliveries, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: WITH delivered AS (SELECT c.customer_state, (o.order_delivered_customer_date::date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date) AS is_late FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL) SELECT customer_state, ROUND((100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_late) / COUNT(*))::numeric, 2) AS late_pct FROM delivered GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY late_pct DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For each seller state, show the number of sellers and the total revenue, rounded to 2 decimals, ordered by revenue descending.
sql: SELECT s.seller_state, COUNT(DISTINCT s.seller_id) AS seller_count, ROUND(SUM(oi.price)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue FROM sellers s JOIN order_items oi ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: What are the top 3 months by revenue across all years?
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.price)::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3;

question: What is the total revenue (sum of item price) from orders placed by customers in the city of Sao Paulo?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_city = 'sao paulo';

question: How many sellers are located in the city of Curitiba?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS sellers_count FROM sellers WHERE seller_city = 'curitiba';

question: How many orders have a status of cancelled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_count FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled';

question: What is the average review score, rounded to 2 decimals, for orders placed by customers in the state of Minas Gerais (MG)?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.review_score)::numeric, 2) AS avg_review_score FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'MG';

question: How many orders were placed during the first quarter of 2018 (January to March)?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01';

question: Which payment type accounts for the most total payment value among orders placed by customers in the state of Rio de Janeiro (RJ)?
sql: SELECT op.payment_type, ROUND(SUM(op.payment_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_payment_value FROM order_payments op JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = op.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ' GROUP BY op.payment_type ORDER BY total_payment_value DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average number of product photos per product, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(product_photos_qty)::numeric, 2) AS avg_photos_per_product FROM products;

question: For the 5 product categories (English name) with the most products, show the category, the number of products, and the average product weight in grams.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, COUNT(*) AS product_count, ROUND(AVG(p.product_weight_g)::numeric, 2) AS avg_weight_g FROM products p LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: How many reviews have a non-empty comment message?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS reviews_with_message FROM order_reviews WHERE review_comment_message IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(review_comment_message) <> '';

question: How many sellers have an average freight value above 20?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sellers_count FROM (SELECT seller_id FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id HAVING AVG(freight_value) > 20) s;

question: For the top 5 cities by number of orders, show the city, the order count, and the average order value (average total payment per order).
sql: WITH order_totals AS (SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_city, SUM(op.payment_value) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_payments op ON op.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id, c.customer_city) SELECT customer_city, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(AVG(order_total)::numeric, 2) AS avg_order_value FROM order_totals GROUP BY customer_city ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the longest estimated delivery window in days, from purchase to estimated delivery date?
sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_estimated_delivery_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS longest_estimated_window_days FROM orders;

question: How many orders placed in 2017 had the status delivered?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_count FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01';

question: Rank the top 10 customer states by total payment value, showing the state, the total payment value, and the rank.
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(op.payment_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_payment_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(op.payment_value) DESC) AS rank FROM order_payments op JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = op.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY total_payment_value DESC LIMIT 10;

question: How many distinct product categories (English name) are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)) AS distinct_categories FROM products p LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name;

question: How many product categories have an average product weight above 2000 grams?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS categories_count FROM (SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category FROM products p LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) HAVING AVG(p.product_weight_g) > 2000) x;

question: For the second half of 2017 (July to December), show each month, the order count, and the change from the previous month.
sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-07-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp)) SELECT month, order_count, order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change_from_previous_month FROM monthly ORDER BY month;

question: What is the average number of payment installments, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_installments)::numeric, 2) AS avg_installments FROM order_payments;

question: For each payment type, show the number of payments and the average payment value, ordered by number of payments descending.
sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, ROUND(AVG(payment_value)::numeric, 2) AS avg_payment_value FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_count DESC;

question: How many products belong to the category beleza_saude?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products_count FROM products WHERE product_category_name = 'beleza_saude';

question: What percentage of delivered orders arrived more than 10 days after the estimated delivery date, rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND((100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_estimated_delivery_date)) / 86400 > 10) / COUNT(*))::numeric, 2) AS pct_more_than_10_days_late FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

question: What is the total freight value for orders placed by customers in the state of Bahia (BA), rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_freight_value FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'BA';

question: Which seller has the highest total freight value?
sql: SELECT seller_id, ROUND(SUM(freight_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_freight_value FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total_freight_value DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For the 3 states with the most customers, show the state, the customer count, and the average review score.
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customer_count, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score)::numeric, 2) AS avg_review_score FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many customers placed orders in more than one distinct calendar month?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_count FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)) > 1) x;

question: What is the average item price in the watches_gifts category (English name), rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(oi.price)::numeric, 2) AS avg_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) = 'watches_gifts';

question: How many orders were placed on a weekend (Saturday or Sunday)?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS weekend_orders FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (0, 6);

question: For each year, show the number of orders and the total revenue (sum of item price).
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(oi.price)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY year;

question: How many orders used more than one payment record?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_count FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) x;

question: What share of total revenue (sum of item price) came from customers in the state of Sao Paulo (SP), rounded to 2 decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND((100.0 * SUM(oi.price) FILTER (WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP') / SUM(oi.price))::numeric, 2) AS sp_revenue_share FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;
